title: Displayed and uploaded trend arror differ
symptom: The trend arrow uploaded to Nightscout is not the same as the one displayed in xDrip. Sometimes the uploaded arrow matches the Dexcom G6, sometimes the displayed one does. Users report that xDrip forwards a steady trend while all arrows should show the same direction (45down). Also, the uploaded delta sometimes differs from the real delta.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. One user speculates that xDrip is sending the arrow derived by the G6 instead of its own calculated arrow, and that different apps group slope ranges differently, but no maintainer confirms a cause.
fix: No fix is provided in the thread. The issue is closed as a duplicate of issue #414, and users are asked to consolidate there.
evidence_quote: I think the problem is that although the xDrip is working out what the arrow should be, it is in fact sending the arrow that the G6 has derived instead.
